name: SuiteUI sources
description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI, linking SuiteModel for SuiteApp): spacing, radius, size, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass applied in one snapshot-aware place (Glass) and GlassPanel; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector) with SidebarSection and SidebarRow; ToolbarGroup palette actions; the content layer (CanvasSurface, SurfaceCard, EmptyStateView, ViewerStatusBar, BusyNote for open, save and import progress, and TransportCapsule, the shared transport over TransportStepping); the editor-kernel chrome (SuiteExportSheet, SuiteStrokePacer, SuitePointerPressure, BrushCursorMark, and ToolKeys, the one tool-letter lookup and the one map from AppKit modifier flags to KeyModifiers); the editor shell after the Ripple editor (EditorShell, EditorTopBar and its bar items, the docked ToolbarGroup rail, CanvasViewport with its Ruler, optional checkerboard, ZoomMath clamped zoom and fit with SuiteCanvasNavigating, the live CanvasNavigating over it, SuiteHandleGeometry, the live HandleGeometryProviding over the kernel's BoxMath and HandleHit, and CanvasMarks with SelectionHandlesEditor, the selection box whose handles resize and rotate it, SegmentedTabs and the ColorWell hex row, with the eyedropper's EyedropperButton, SampleLoupe and SampleSizeChips); pro inspector parts (InspectorHeader, InspectorRows, ScrubField and NumericInput number entry); the Studio easing parts (CurveEditor, StudioScrubRow, ChoiceChips); ShapeToolOptions, the shape tool's kind chips and per-kind rows with their range help; AppMark, the one view that draws an app's mark (icon, glyph or line style) from AppMarkArt, path data scripts/render-marks generates from Bundle/Marks; ThumbnailGrid with its selection math; HistoryPanel, the one History panel over the kernel's HistoryListing, and the autosaveRecovery modifier over SuiteModel's RecoveryFolder (autosave-history); StrokeEditor, the one stroke editor, which sends the kernel's StrokeIntents and never edits a document (stroke-style); and TimelineStrip with its frame mapping, shared by Flare and Halo, with TimelineLaneLayers, the rules of its AppKit lanes renderer (which lanes redraw from an Equatable diff, a layer frame per lane, a press routed to the lane classification); MenuCommand, the one menu item, built from a SuiteKernel CommandSpec (MenuCommand+Catalog) so its title, enabled state and why-not help come from the app's command catalog; SuiteGallery, the component gallery the journeys drive, with a command-catalog page over the kernel's FakeCanvasDocument; and PathEditOverlay with PenTool, the Pen and point editor's overlay (a placeholder drawing the path only, on a local contour stand-in until the kernel's path types land). HistogramView (a ToneHistogram's bins in the field well with shadow and highlight clipping markers), shared by Library's develop panel and Photo's Levels. UnsavedGuard is the one unsaved-changes asker: the unsavedChangesGuard modifier and UnsavedGuard.proceed show the kernel's UnsavedPrompt as a Save, Don't Save or Cancel sheet before a dirty window closes, its document is replaced or the app quits (adopt-kernel-unsaved-prompt).
